cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We split the bill exactly. Now toss for who apologises to the waiter. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Otherwise this dinner ends without a distinction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then least enthusiastic enjoyment pays the tip. Rate yours carefully.

mechanism: A turns an equal dinner split into a tip-paying tiebreak and adapts the test to B claim of equal enjoyment.
confusable: Unlike charging a normal shared bill, A insists an even outcome must create a loser under a new rule.
comparison: Meal ratings and fallback coin toss differ from blindfolded icing after tied cakes.
seedUse: D211-b equal bill and enjoyed meal; S02-b offers B coin-side choice while arranging the formal consequence.
